WITH hourly_stats AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS day,
        slave_id,
        channel,
        SUM(value) AS hourly_sum
    FROM
        channel_pulse_log
    WHERE
        timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
        AND (slave_id, channel) IN {{{ msg.payload.devices }}}
        AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp) = EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW())
    GROUP BY
        day, slave_id, channel
),
daily_min_max AS (
    SELECT
        slave_id,
        channel,
        MIN(hourly_sum) AS daily_min_sum,
        MAX(hourly_sum) AS daily_max_sum
    FROM
        hourly_stats
    GROUP BY
        slave_id, channel
)
SELECT
    date_trunc('hour', NOW()) AS reference_hour,
    slave_id,
    channel,
    ROUND(AVG(daily_min_sum), 2) AS avg_min_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(daily_max_sum), 2) AS avg_max_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(hourly_sum), 2) AS avg_sum
FROM
    hourly_stats
    JOIN daily_min_max USING (slave_id, channel)
GROUP BY
    reference_hour, slave_id, channel;

WITH channel_info AS (
    SELECT
        slave_id,
        name,
        COALESCE(CAST((regexp_match(name, 'x([0-9.]+)'))[1] AS FLOAT), 1) AS multiplier
    FROM
        channels
    WHERE
        slave_id = ANY (ARRAY[{{ msg.payload }}])
        AND channel = 1
),
hourly_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.slave_id,
        time_bucket('1 hour', cpl.timestamp) AS consumption_hour,
        SUM(cpl.value) AS hourly_consumption_L
    FROM
        channel_info c
    INNER JOIN
        channel_pulse_log cpl
        ON c.slave_id = cpl.slave_id
        AND cpl.timestamp >= TO_TIMESTAMP({{ msg.req.params.start_ts }}::bigint / 1000)
        AND cpl.timestamp < TO_TIMESTAMP({{ msg.req.params.end_ts }}::bigint / 1000)
        AND cpl.value >= 0
        AND cpl.channel = 1
    GROUP BY
        c.slave_id, consumption_hour
),
totals_per_slave AS (
    SELECT
        slave_id,
        SUM(hourly_consumption_L) AS total_consumption_L,
        COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM consumption_hour)) AS active_hours,
        MAX(hourly_consumption_L) AS max_hourly_consumption_L,
        MIN(hourly_consumption_L) AS min_hourly_consumption_L
    FROM
        hourly_metrics
    GROUP BY
        slave_id
),
max_min_hours AS (
    SELECT
        h.slave_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN h.hourly_consumption_L = d.max_hourly_consumption_L 
                 THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.consumption_hour) END) AS hour_of_max_consumption,
        MIN(CASE WHEN h.hourly_consumption_L = d.min_hourly_consumption_L 
                 THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.consumption_hour) END) AS hour_of_min_consumption
    FROM
        hourly_metrics h
    JOIN
        totals_per_slave d ON h.slave_id = d.slave_id
    GROUP BY
        h.slave_id
)
SELECT
    c.slave_id,
    c.name AS device_name,
    COALESCE(d.total_consumption_L, 0) AS total_consumption_L,
    c.multiplier,
    (COALESCE(d.total_consumption_L, 0) * c.multiplier) / 1000 AS total_consumption_m3,
    COALESCE(d.active_hours, 0) AS active_hours,
    COALESCE(d.max_hourly_consumption_L, 0) AS max_hourly_consumption_L,
    COALESCE(d.min_hourly_consumption_L, 0) AS min_hourly_consumption_L,
    m.hour_of_max_consumption,
    m.hour_of_min_consumption
FROM
    channel_info c
LEFT JOIN
    totals_per_slave d ON c.slave_id = d.slave_id
LEFT JOIN
    max_min_hours m ON c.slave_id = m.slave_id
ORDER BY

WITH LastTimestamp AS (
  SELECT MAX(timestamp) AS max_timestamp
  FROM channel_pulse_log
),
TimeDiff AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    channel,
    value,
    slave_id,
    reading,
    LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY slave_id, channel ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_timestamp,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY slave_id, channel ORDER BY timestamp))) AS time_diff_seconds
  FROM channel_pulse_log
  WHERE
    channel = 1
    AND timestamp >= (SELECT max_timestamp - INTERVAL '15 minutes' FROM LastTimestamp)
    AND timestamp <= (SELECT max_timestamp FROM LastTimestamp)
),
Outliers AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    channel,
    value,
    slave_id,
    reading,
    time_diff_seconds,
    (time_diff_seconds * 3) AS max_allowable_value
  FROM TimeDiff
  WHERE
    value > (time_diff_seconds * 3)
    AND value > 10
),
UpdatedRows AS (
  UPDATE channel_pulse_log cpl
  SET value = 0
  FROM Outliers
  WHERE
    cpl.timestamp = Outliers.timestamp
    AND cpl.slave_id = Outliers.slave_id
    AND cpl.channel = Outliers.channel
    AND cpl.value = Outliers.value
    AND cpl.reading = Outliers.reading

WITH raw_ts AS (
  -- 1) use exactly what the cloud sent, or fall back to the first 2023+ reading
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('{{{ msg.payload.last_water_ts }}}','')::timestamptz,
      (
        SELECT MIN(timestamp)
        FROM channel_pulse_log
        WHERE timestamp > '2025-06-18 12:00:00'
          AND channel = 1
      )
    ) AS start_ts
),
channel_info AS (
  -- 2) lookup your per-slave multiplier
  SELECT
    slave_id,
    MAX(
      COALESCE(
        (regexp_match(name, 'x([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)'))[1]::float,
        1
      )
    ) AS multiplier
  FROM channels
  WHERE channel = 1
    AND type = 'flow_sensor'
    AND slave_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY slave_id
),
bounds AS (
  -- 3) from that start_ts, either take a full hour (if there's data),
  --    or jump to the end of the very next non-empty 5m bucket
  SELECT
    r.start_ts,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM channel_pulse_log c
        JOIN channel_info ci ON c.slave_id = ci.slave_id
        WHERE c.timestamp > r.start_ts
          AND c.timestamp <= r.start_ts + INTERVAL '1 hour'
          AND c.channel = 1
          AND c.value > 0
          AND c.value < 10000
      )
      THEN r.start_ts + INTERVAL '1 hour'
      ELSE (
        SELECT MIN(time_bucket('5 minutes', c2.timestamp) + INTERVAL '5 minutes')
        FROM channel_pulse_log c2
        JOIN channel_info ci2 ON c2.slave_id = ci2.slave_id
        WHERE c2.timestamp > r.start_ts
          AND c2.channel = 1
          AND c2.value > 0
          AND c2.value < 10000
      )
    END AS end_ts
  FROM raw_ts r
),
main_data AS (
  -- 4) aggregate pulses in that (start_ts, end_ts] window
  SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', c.timestamp) AS bucket_start,
    c.slave_id,
    SUM(c.value) AS sum_value,
    (SUM(c.value) * ci.multiplier) / 1000 AS value
  FROM channel_pulse_log c
  JOIN channel_info ci ON c.slave_id = ci.slave_id
  JOIN bounds b ON TRUE
  WHERE
    c.timestamp > b.start_ts
    AND c.timestamp <= b.end_ts
    AND c.channel = 1
    AND c.value > 0
    AND c.value < 10000
  GROUP BY bucket_start, c.slave_id, ci.multiplier
)
-- 5) return one row per slave_id with total sum_value and value
SELECT
  (SELECT end_ts FROM bounds) AS timestamp,
  slave_id,
  SUM(sum_value) AS sum_value,
  SUM(value) AS value,
  1 AS channel
FROM main_data
GROUP BY slave_id
ORDER BY slave_id;

      END,

    COALESCE(
      -- Apply same multiplier to reactive power
      CASE 
        WHEN s.name ~ 'x([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)[^V]' OR s.name ~ 'x([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)$'
        THEN (regexp_match(s.name, 'x([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)'))[1]::float

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(NULLIF('{{{ msg.payload.last_water_ts }}}','')::timestamptz,
               '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz),
      '2024-12-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz   -- clamp (Dec 1, 2024 UTC)
    ) AS requested_start,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{{ msg.payload.lookahead_hours }}}','')::int, 24) AS lookahead_hours
),
look_window AS (
  SELECT
    p.requested_start AS from_ts,
    p.requested_start + make_interval(hours => p.lookahead_hours) AS to_ts
  FROM params p
),
-- one multiplier per slave (from CHANNEL name where channel=1)
channel_info AS (
  SELECT
    c.slave_id,
    MAX(COALESCE((regexp_match(c.name, 'x([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)'))[1]::float, 1.0)) AS multiplier
  FROM channels c
  WHERE c.channel = 1
    AND c.type = 'flow_sensor'
    AND c.slave_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.slave_id
),
-- first 5-min bucket with data >= requested_start (bounded look-ahead)
first_bucket AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', MIN(c.timestamp)) AS start_bucket
  FROM channel_pulse_log c
  JOIN channel_info ci ON ci.slave_id = c.slave_id
  JOIN look_window w ON c.timestamp >= w.from_ts AND c.timestamp < w.to_ts
  WHERE c.channel = 1
    AND c.value BETWEEN 1 AND 9999
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    fb.start_bucket AS start_bucket,
    fb.start_bucket + INTERVAL '1 hour' AS end_ts,
    fb.start_bucket + INTERVAL '55 minutes' AS last_bucket
  FROM first_bucket fb
  WHERE fb.start_bucket IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate only actual data in [start_bucket, start_bucket+1h)
agg AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', c.timestamp) AS bucket_ts,
    c.slave_id,
    SUM(c.value) AS sum_value
  FROM channel_pulse_log c
  JOIN bounds b ON TRUE
  WHERE c.timestamp >= b.start_bucket
    AND c.timestamp <  b.end_ts
    AND c.channel = 1
    AND c.value BETWEEN 1 AND 9999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
-- add ONE cursor bucket per slave at the last bucket if it's missing
cursor_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.last_bucket AS bucket_ts,
    ci.slave_id,
    0::bigint     AS sum_value
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN channel_info ci
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM agg a
    WHERE a.bucket_ts = b.last_bucket
      AND a.slave_id = ci.slave_id
  )
)
SELECT
  a.bucket_ts                            AS "timestamp",
  a.slave_id,
  1                                      AS channel_id,
  (a.sum_value * ci.multiplier) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM cursor_rows
) a
JOIN channel_info ci ON ci.slave_id = a.slave_id
ORDER BY "timestamp", slave_id;

F5 → pede PIN. Reconexão de socket → mantém sessão. Reload automático nosso → mantém sessão. Três cenários corretos.

Novo `_shouldShowBootlock()` mantém a tela de "Carregando" / "Aguardando identificação do operador..." bloqueando qualquer interação enquanto `currentUser=null` e `aclShow=false` e existirem users configurados. query:
-- Consumo dia/semana/mês por (slave_id,channel), fuso America/Sao_Paulo, filtro outliers (<=3 pulsos/s).
WITH b AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS d0,
         (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS w0,
         (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS m0
),
steps AS (
  SELECT p.slave_id, p.channel, p.timestamp, p.reading,
         p.reading - LAG(p.reading) OVER wnd AS dr,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.timestamp - LAG(p.timestamp) OVER wnd)) AS ds
    FROM channel_pulse_log p, b
   WHERE p.timestamp >= b.m0 - interval '2 days'
  WINDOW wnd AS (PARTITION BY p.slave_id, p.channel ORDER BY p.timestamp)
)
SELECT s.slave_id, s.channel,
  MAX(s.reading) AS total,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dr IS NOT NULL AND dr >= 0 AND ds > 0 AND dr <= 3*ds THEN dr ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE s.timestamp >= b.d0), 0) AS day,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dr IS NOT NULL AND dr >= 0 AND ds > 0 AND dr <= 3*ds THEN dr ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE s.timestamp >= b.w0), 0) AS week,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dr IS NOT NULL AND dr >= 0 AND ds > 0 AND dr <= 3*ds THEN dr ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE s.timestamp >= b.m0), 0) AS month,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(s.timestamp))*1000 AS last_ms
FROM steps s, b
GROUP BY s.slave_id, s.channel;

# Botão "🔄 Atualizar" do Medidor de Energia

O UI envia `{topic:"checkslave", payload:{slave:{id:<meterId>}}}` para cá.

## O que fazer

1. Localize o nó **`topic?`** (renomeado para `topic? · saída 21 = checkslave`)
2. A **última saída** (número 21, a mais de baixo) é onde chega a mensagem `checkslave`
3. **Arraste um cabo dessa última saída** até o seu nó `Send Check`
4. Deploy

Também deixei um debug node ligado nessa saída pra você ver a mensagem chegar quando clicar Atualizar.

Depois pode desconectar o debug se quiser — ele é só pra teste inicial.
